statement: With N=10000 commuting Gaussian patterns in d=50, 7500 perturbed queries converge at beta=1 but fail to converge at beta=0.1, for radii 1/sqrt(beta N) and 100/sqrt(beta N).
acceptance: Every Algorithm 2 memory and query satisfies the exact numerical contract.
At beta=1 both radii have at least 99.9% convergence by iteration 3.
At beta=0.1 both radii have at most 1% convergence by iteration 3.
Confidence intervals preserve the success/failure separation.
An independent loop implementation agrees with the vectorized Algorithm 1 update.
A beta=0 uniform-weight control fails retrieval.
